interpretation.label: effort_proxy_live_scale_inert
interpretation.summary: C1 3/3 seeds, C2 0/3 (best cost), C2_default 0/3, C3 0/3; ready=True
interpretation.routing: calibration: the effort term COULD reach the top-2 gap on some ticks yet the argmin did not respond at the pre-registered costs; puzzle (known rules)

preconditions.name: c2_denominator_min
preconditions.control: worst seed; C2's OWN denominator (ticks with a valid f-sweep, min over costs) -- the sample the load-bearing fraction is computed on

preconditions.name: c1_c2_denominator_gap
preconditions.control: max over seeds; C1 ticks minus C2 ticks -- C1 and C2 must be read on the SAME fresh ticks (a dropped tick class would bias C2)

preconditions.name: counterfactual_fidelity
preconditions.control: worst seed; an UNPATCHED deep copy must reproduce the real call's argmin

preconditions.name: neg_control_horizon_flip_frac
preconditions.control: max over seeds; horizon effort is constant -> argmin-invariant by arithmetic; any flip means the counterfactual instrument is broken

preconditions.name: pos_control_injected_flip_frac
preconditions.control: worst seed; effort injected on the argmin candidate, sized from a measured unit shift to cross the runner-up gap between f_min and f=1, must flip the argmin

preconditions.name: last_scores_bounded_growth_ratio
preconditions.control: max over seeds; |e3.last_scores| last/first decile of P2 -- the payoff self-feedback must be at a stationary operating point, not integrating

interpretation.what_a_null_does_not_mean: C2 failing at every cost is a calibration finding (the effort term cannot compete with the E3 payoff range), not evidence against SD-032b; C3 failing says the proxy is live but not harm-predictive (expected under SD-PP-B9), not that a harm-forward cost is the wrong proxy.
interpretation.dv_symmetry: ON: f_sat x cost scales a per-candidate effort vector -> not a uniform shift, argmin not invariant. horizon control: constant effort -> broadcast scalar, argmin-invariant by arithmetic -> scoped out of scoring, used only as the negative-control precondition.
